-- Quest #1000 / Scene #14 - Function talkevent10_1
function talkevent10_1()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	SetFinalMusic("")
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("Square03D.fld")
	MoveCamera(705.00, 793.00, 145.61)
	RotCamera(3.00, 1.47, 24.00)

	CreateObject(0, 10338, 869.00, 1052.00, 0, 0, FALSE, 0, 0)

	CreateObject(5, 10049, 882.00, 970.00, 224, 0, FALSE, 0, 0)

	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	wait(4000)
	PlayCameraNoWait("talkevent10_1_01.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	AniObject(1, 2, 1)
	AniObject(3, 2, 1)
	AniObject(4, 2, 1)
	AniObject(0, 51, 1)
	wait(2000)
	WalkObject(2, 685.000000, 800.000000, 0.000000, 1, 4, 2)
	wait(4000)
	RotateObject(1, 160, 1)
	RotateObject(3, 160, 1)
	RotateObject(4, 160, 1)
	AniObject(2, 2, 1)
	OpenTalkScene(3, 14)
	FadeOut(100)
	WalkObject(1, 851.000000, 946.000000, 0.000000, 1, 4, 2)
	WalkObject(2, 851.000000, 939.000000, 0.000000, 1, 4, 2)
	WalkObject(3, 858.000000, 946.000000, 0.000000, 1, 4, 2)
	WalkObject(4, 858.000000, 939.000000, 0.000000, 1, 4, 2)

	WarpObject(1, 851.000000, 946.000000, 0.000000, 96, 1, 1)
	WarpObject(2, 851.000000, 939.000000, 0.000000, 96, 1, 1)
	WarpObject(3, 858.000000, 946.000000, 0.000000, 96, 1, 1)
	WarpObject(4, 858.000000, 939.000000, 0.000000, 96, 1, 1)
